jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
First, What We’re Actually Doing
Fours is the end-to-end orchestration system for the fastest-growing sales channels: B2B marketplaces and ecosystems, powered by AI and integrations with the systems businesses already use.
Today, we work with 300+ amazing customers, ranging from leading AI companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, Decagon, and Glean to large enterprises like Snowflake, Workday, and Intel.
We’ve built products customers love and a sales motion that works. Now, we need to make sure the market understands exactly why we’re different, why we’re winning, and why customers choose us.
As our Product Marketing Manager, you’ll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing. You’ll own how we position our products, tell our story, launch new capabilities, enable our sales team, and turn customer and market insights into a competitive advantage.
This is not a traditional product marketing role where you inherit a playbook and spend your time managing launch calendars. We’re looking for someone who can operate with a high degree of ownership, get deep into the product, understand our buyers, and turn complex technology into clear, compelling messaging.

What You'll Own (for real)
- Own positioning and messaging: Develop clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for Fours products, translating complex product capabilities into compelling value propositions for different audiences and use cases.

- Own go-to-market strategy: Partner with Product, Sales, and Marketing to develop GTM strategies for new products, features, and markets, from launch planning through post-launch optimization.

- Build sales enablement: Create the messaging, competitive battlecards, pitch decks, demos, one-pagers, case studies, and other materials Sales needs to win.

- Own competitive intelligence: Develop a deep understanding of our competitive landscape, including PRM, marketplace, channel commerce, and adjacent platforms. Track competitors, identify market gaps, and turn insights into actionable sales and product strategies.

- Become an expert on our customers: Talk to customers and prospects to understand their pain points, buying decisions, objections, and use cases. Turn those insights into better positioning, messaging, and product strategy.

- Create product marketing content: Develop high-quality content that brings our products and point of view to life, including product pages, launch content, thought leadership, customer stories, and sales collateral.

- Partner with Product: Work closely with Product and Engineering to understand what we’re building, shape how we take it to market, and ensure product development is grounded in customer and market needs.

- Partner with Sales: Work directly with Sales to understand what is and isn’t resonating in the market, improve our sales narrative, and help the team win competitive deals.
We're Looking For
- 4+ years of B2B product marketing experience , ideally at an early-stage, high-growth SaaS or technology company.

- A track record of owning positioning, messaging, launches, and GTM programs from strategy through execution.

- Strong ability to translate technical products into simple, compelling stories that resonate with business and technical buyers.

- Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills with strong creative instincts.

- Experience working closely with Sales and Product to develop messaging, enablement, and go-to-market strategies.

- Strong competitive intelligence and market research skills, with the ability to turn information into actionable insights.

- Highly analytical and comfortable using customer feedback, win/loss data, pipeline data, and market research to inform decisions.

- Hands-on and highly execution-oriented. You enjoy figuring things out and doing the work yourself.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment without a large team or established playbook.

- Experience with AI products, B2B SaaS, cloud marketplaces, partnerships, or ecosystem-led growth is a strong plus.

- High ownership, strong judgment, and a bias toward action.
Why Join Us
- Be one of our first marketing hires: Help define how Fours tells its story to the market. You’ll have the autonomy to shape our positioning, messaging, launches, and product marketing function.

- Work at the intersection of Product and Sales: Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership to influence what we build, how we launch it, and how we win in the market.

- Build at an inflection point: Fours has strong product-market fit, 300+ customers, and a proven sales motion. Now you’ll have the opportunity to sharpen our story, accelerate our GTM, and help define a category.

- Work with an exceptional team: Join a driven team of ~74 people with experience at companies like Google, Meta, Salesforce, Asana, Confluent, and Square.

- Move fast and own your work: We’re a fast-moving company with a flat organizational structure and a strong bias toward action. We value autonomy, good judgment, and getting things done over hierarchy and process.

- Competitive compensation: $130K–$180K/year base salary, plus meaningful equity, comprehensive health benefits, and monthly office stipends.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us
Fours (formerly Suger.io) helps B2B software companies sell through cloud marketplaces like AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle, Alibaba, and Snowflake — now one of the fastest-growing enterprise sales channels.
Marketplace sales are operationally complex: pricing, contracting, billing, revenue recognition, and compliance all intersect across multiple cloud providers. Suger removes this complexity with an API-first revenue platform that powers quote-to-cash and marketplace workflows at scale.
Launched in 2022, Suger works with over 300 B2B customers, from large enterprises like Snowflake and Intel to fast-growing startups like Glean and Vanta. We’re a Series A company backed by Threshold VC, Craft Ventures, Intel Capital, and Y Combinator.
We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the product roadmap for Insulin, our new product focused on AI-driven automation across revenue operations. You’ll lead the strategy, product design, and execution of Insulin from the ground up, turning complex revenue workflows into intelligent, reliable, and intuitive experiences for our customers.

In this role, you will
- Own the product roadmap for intelligent systems that automate pricing, contracting, billing, and compliance workflows, with a focus on building AI-powered products that meaningfully improve how customers operate.

- Design end-to-end user journeys and product experiences for AI-powered workflows , bringing strong product taste to every interaction. Translate complex technical capabilities into intuitive, transparent experiences and continuously iterate based on real customer behavior and feedback.

- Partner closely with engineering to turn AI capabilities into reliable production features , balancing customer impact, system reliability, model behavior, and engineering complexity when making product decisions. Ensure AI-powered experiences are correct, explainable, and trustworthy.

- Define and track success metrics including adoption, accuracy, efficiency gains, automation rates, and customer outcomes, using both quantitative data and qualitative feedback to guide product iteration.

- Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions teams to gather qualitative and quantitative feedback and occasionally support onboarding, developing a deep understanding of customer workflows, edge cases, and trust concerns around AI-driven automation.
We're seeking someone with experience including:
- 4+ years of Product Management or Product Design experience in technology, ideally within B2B SaaS, developer platforms, or enterprise software, with a portfolio or track record demonstrating strong product and design judgment.

- Track record of shipping AI-powered features to production , with strong judgment around where automation creates value and where human oversight is necessary to earn user trust.

- Strong product design sensibility , with an eye for interaction details, intuitive workflows, and polished user experiences, not just requirements and specifications.

- Comfort with technical complexity , including systems such as billing infrastructure, APIs, data pipelines, or fintech and compliance workflows. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable going deep with one.

- Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner , able to work effectively with engineering, GTM, and customers to turn complex problems into clear product decisions.

- Startup mindset , with a bias toward action, comfort with ambiguity, and a strong sense of ownership from customer discovery through launch and iteration.
Why You Join Us
- Base Pay Range: $130,000 - 180,000 CAD

- Competitive compensation and equity package.

- Monthly office stipends, including lunch and commuting benefits.

- Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including extended health, dental, vision, and life insurance.

- Work alongside a world-class team with experience at Google, Meta, Salesforce, Pave, Motive, and Square, building AI agent and AI infrastructure SaaS that powers critical revenue workflows.

- Own a major pillar of our product strategy from day one , with the autonomy to shape the roadmap, make high-impact product decisions, and build experiences you believe will create meaningful customer value.

- Join a fast-moving, flat organization with strong product-market fit and ambitious goals , where you’ll ship quickly, influence the roadmap, and see the direct impact of your work with customers.
